category_edits.rationale: Add a modest unweighted pairwise ranking term to the existing weighted loss to improve positive-negative separation across all four datasets. Reuse existing scores and masks, preserving the GRU architecture, sampling, optimizer, schedule, routing, and single-model checkpoints.

change_summary: Add 0.1 × mean(softplus(s_neg − s_pos)) to the existing loss. No predictor changes are required.
